# Drop-in Equivalence Checklist: Hologram Server v1

**Purpose**: Test whether the requirements that define "drop-in" are complete, clear and measurable. It tests the writing, not the build.
**Created**: 2026-09-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the exact version of the reference registry named, or only "pinned"? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the "documented subset" of the settings file listed key by key? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the supported environment settings listed, or is "the reference's environment settings" meant to be all of them? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the peer registries for gates D and E named in the spec, with how often each runs? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the fixed image set for round trip copies defined (sizes, multi-platform images, signed images, non-image artifacts)? [Gap, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are logging and health reporting requirements defined, given operators read the reference's logs today? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the behaviour of the base address and health route stated beyond "returns success"? [Completeness, Spec §Story 1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "behave the same" bounded: which headers count, and are header order and timing excluded? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the spec say who may add an entry to the differences file, and what makes a difference acceptable? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "safe to re-run" for import defined as a testable property? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "standalone binaries" tied to a named list of systems, given Windows is first in the cut order? [Conflict, Spec §FR-016 vs §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "an upload can continue after restart" bounded by a session lifetime? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Are SC-006 and SC-007 tied to a stated machine, disk and network so the 20% and 200 MB limits can be reproduced? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-001 "under 5 minutes" be measured, and does it include image pull time? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Does every functional requirement map to at least one gate or acceptance scenario? FR-015 and FR-016 appear to have none in gates A to E. [Traceability, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-008 "any tested sequence" backed by a defined list of sequences? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Is garbage collection during an active push specified by the product, or deferred to "the reference's documented behaviour" without stating it? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for running out of disk during garbage collection or import, not only during a push? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Are rollback requirements defined for a failed or partial import? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the verify command's behaviour on a store that is being written to defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK021 Is there a requirement for what verify does after it finds damage (report only, quarantine, refuse to serve)? [Gap, Spec §Story 4]
- [ ] CHK022 Are upgrade requirements defined between two product versions with data in place? [Gap]

## Security

- [ ] CHK023 Is it stated whether the garbage collection and import commands need access control, given the underlying store runs them open today? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for password file reload without restart, as the reference does? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the minimum TLS version stated or inherited from the reference? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK026 Does the spec state that bytes are hashed on write, as the constitution requires, or only that they can be verified later? [Consistency, Constitution §II vs Spec §FR-014]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 Is the fallback stated if the two day store trial fails, or only "scope is revisited"? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Does the cut order conflict with requirements written as MUST (FR-008 TLS, FR-014 verify, FR-016 binaries)? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the unverified day estimate separated from any commitment in the success criteria? [Assumption]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- Strongest findings: CHK028 (cut order contradicts MUST requirements), CHK026 (hash on write is missing from the requirements), CHK015 (two requirements no gate checks), CHK021 (verify has no defined consequence).
- 2026-09-21, planning: `plan.md` section 8 names the items the plan answers (CHK001 to CHK005, 008, 009, 011, 013 to 015, 017, 020, 021, 023, 026 to 028) and where. Boxes stay unchecked: marking them is the reviewer's call. Still open: CHK006, CHK022, CHK024 (built in P6 T1, not yet a spec line), CHK025.
